content_feed.telegram_post: 💵 #DIVIDEND | MRF Limited (NSE: MRF) MRF Declares Interim Dividend of Rs. 3 Per Share ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Dividend per Share: Rs. 3 (30% on face value of Rs. 10) - Dividend Type: Interim Dividend - Record Date: Tuesday, November 17, 2026 - Payment Date: On or after December 1, 2026 📌 What happened: ↳ The Board of Directors declared an interim dividend for the financial year ending March 31, 2027, during their meeting held on November 10, 2026. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Vardhman Holdings Reports September Quarter Financial Results
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Financial results containing explicit quarterly Revenue and PAT figures.
content_feed.telegram_post: 📊 #RESULT | Vardhman Holdings Limited (NSE: VHL) Vardhman Holdings Reports September Quarter Financial Results ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Total Revenue from Operations (Q2 FY27): Rs. 64.43 Crores - Net Profit After Tax (Q2 FY27): Rs. 49.99 Crores - Total Income (Q2 FY27): Rs. 64.97 Crores - Profit Before Tax (Q2 FY27): Rs. 62.33 Crores 📌 What happened: ↳ The company's Board of Directors approved the un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, during their meeting held on November 10, 2026. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
